a_item_map.A1: probe_vdev.py: 8 virtual B300 devices via NVML; checks device_count_is_N, name_is_D1, total_mem_is_D1, sm_count_is_D1, uuid_prefix, nvml_private_count, matmul_err. Run = increment 1.
a_item_map.A2: probe_a2.py: probe_nodes.py normal run must have 64 distinct D1 PCI bus ids and each child exactly 8; the --all-node 0 run must FAIL the same checks (distinct ids = 8 != 64) and exit nonzero, as expected. Run = increment 0.
a_item_map.A3: moved to gpu-sim-s2vc (NCCL topology XML/IB choice); not claimed here.
a_item_map.A4: gpu-sim-7q3w.5 owns NCCL numerics; increment 2 is a gloo control-plane all_reduce only.
a_item_map.A5: probe_reference.py: 8-way DDP final loss and parameters vs a 1-way reference with the same seed/data; TOL=5e-4 absolute. Run = increment 4.
a_item_map.A6: moved to gpu-sim-ae2v (fabric timing); no timing claim here.
a_item_map.A7: not separately rerun here; increment 3's checkpoint hash was reproduced by the PI, and 7q3w.3's 20-run transport arm owns the exit distribution.
a_item_map.A8: metrics.error_budget.ram: preflight 10576 MiB, PI pass 10633/10576 (57 MiB margin), PI refusal 10496; this capture records its own start/end.

d4_coverage.model: probe_training.py and probe_reference.py: 4-layer TransformerEncoder, d_model=512, ff=2048, 12,609,536 params, AdamW lr=1e-3, 3 steps, 8 DDP ranks, rank-sharded data.
d4_coverage.launcher: run.sh picks one increment; capture.py waits for that increment's preflight floor, records exit codes and MemAvailable before/after, and writes output.log/metrics.json/job.json.
d4_coverage.d2: probe_nodes.py and probe_a2.py: 8 OS processes x 8 devices, 64 distinct D1 bus ids, negative control fails without isolation.
d4_coverage.d3: probe_vdev.py: real driver/cudart/NVML identity through the shims; probe_distributed.py: one rank per node.
d4_coverage.d4: probe_training.py + probe_reference.py + run.sh + capture.py, as above; this is the model/launcher pair, not a claim of GPU kernels.
